name: KUNAL STREAMER
description: A Pyrogram Telegram bot to Stream Telegram files to web. 🚀

ENV.description: Set this to True if you don't want to crash the bot ⚠️

APP_NAME.description: Copy-Paste the app name that you just typed above. 📲

BIN_CHANNEL.description: The BIN Channel ID. Read the readme for more info about this var 📚

NEW_USER_LOG.description: The NEW_USER_LOG Channel ID. Add this to get new users log 📝

DATABASE_URL.description: MongoDB URI for saving User IDs when they first Start the Bot. We will use that for Broadcasting to them 📊. Check readme for more details.

BANNED_CHANNELS.description: Put IDs of Banned Channels where bot will not work (bot will leave that channel). You can add multiple IDs & separate with Space 🚫.

BAN_CHNL.description: Almost same as BANNED_CHANNELS but if you add a channel ID here, the bot will stay in that channel but will not generate streaming link for it ⚠️.

UPDATES_CHANNEL.description: Put a Public Channel Username without @, so every user has to Join that channel to use the bot 📢. Must add bot to channel as Admin for proper functioning.

OWNER_USERNAME.description: Enter your username without @. Example: Kunal

SLEEP_THRESHOLD.description: Floodwait Sleep timer 🕑. Read the readme for more info about this var 📖

WORKERS.description: Number of workers to be assigned 🔧. Read the readme for more info about this var 📝

PORT.description: Port that you want your webapp to listen to 🌐. Default is 8080.

NO_PORT.description: If you don't want your port to be displayed 🚫. Read the readme for more info about this var 📘.

HAS_SSL.description: Default value is True ✅ for secure connections.

BIND_ADRESS.description: Read the readme for more info about this var 📚. Leave empty for Heroku.

FQDN.description: Read the readme for more info about this var 📖. Leave empty for Heroku.

BAN_ALERT.description: [Optional] Add the text you wish to display when attempting to get links while banned 🚫
